import Lean
import Effect4.Target.TypeScript.Expr

open Lean hiding Expr
open Effect4.Target.TypeScript

namespace ExprEqualityTrustRegression

-- These are finite behavioral checks of the existing public equality.
private def samples : List Expr := [
  .ident "name",
  .str "value",
  .int (-7),
  .float64Bits 0x7ff8000000000001,
  .bool true,
  .jsNull,
  .call (.ident "fn") [.arr [.str "argument", .jsNull]],
  .object [("key", .call (.ident "fn") [.int 1])],
  .objectML [("key", .arr [.bool false])],
  .objectQuoted [("key", .object [])],
  .objectQuotedML [("key", .objectQuoted [])],
  .objectFromEntries [("__proto__", .objectML [])],
  .arr [.objectFromEntries [("key", .str "value")]],
  .arrow (some "Result") (.arrow none (.ident "body"))
]

#guard samples.length == 14
#guard samples.all fun value => value == value
#guard samples.zipIdx |>.all fun (left, leftIndex) =>
  samples.zipIdx |>.all fun (right, rightIndex) =>
    (left == right) == (leftIndex == rightIndex)

private def scalarAndRecursiveDifferences : List (Expr × Expr) := [
  (.ident "left", .ident "right"),
  (.str "left", .str "right"),
  (.int (-1), .int 1),
  (.float64Bits 0, .float64Bits 0x8000000000000000),
  (.float64Bits 0x7ff8000000000001, .float64Bits 0x7ff8000000000002),
  (.bool true, .bool false),
  (.call (.ident "left") [], .call (.ident "right") []),
  (.call (.ident "fn") [.int 1], .call (.ident "fn") [.int 2]),
  (.call (.ident "fn") [], .call (.ident "fn") [.jsNull]),
  (.call (.ident "fn") [.int 1, .int 2], .call (.ident "fn") [.int 2, .int 1]),
  (.arr [], .arr [.jsNull]),
  (.arr [.int 1, .int 2], .arr [.int 2, .int 1]),
  (.arr [.arr [.str "left"]], .arr [.arr [.str "right"]]),
  (.arrow none .jsNull, .arrow (some "Result") .jsNull),
  (.arrow (some "Left") .jsNull, .arrow (some "Right") .jsNull),
  (.arrow none (.ident "left"), .arrow none (.ident "right")),
  (.arrow none (.arrow none (.arr [.int 1])),
    .arrow none (.arrow none (.arr [.int 2])))
]

#guard scalarAndRecursiveDifferences.all fun (left, right) =>
  !(left == right) && !(right == left)

private def fieldConstructors : List (List (String × Expr) → Expr) :=
  [.object, .objectML, .objectQuoted, .objectQuotedML, .objectFromEntries]

#guard fieldConstructors.all fun make =>
  make [] == make [] &&
  make [("key", .arr [.int 1])] == make [("key", .arr [.int 1])] &&
  !(make [] == make [("key", .jsNull)]) &&
  !(make [("left", .jsNull)] == make [("right", .jsNull)]) &&
  !(make [("key", .arr [.int 1])] == make [("key", .arr [.int 2])]) &&
  !(make [("first", .int 1), ("second", .int 2)] ==
    make [("second", .int 2), ("first", .int 1)])

run_elab do
  logInfo "PASS finite Expr equality probes: all constructors, nested values, field order, and float bits"

-- The public instance and its helper retain their existing names. The helper
-- must have a total body available to Lean; an opaque implementation fails.
run_elab do
  let environment ← Lean.getEnv
  let mut failures : Array String := #[]
  unless environment.contains ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.instBEqExpr do
    failures := failures.push "missing public instBEqExpr"
  match environment.find? ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.instBEqExpr.beq with
  | some (.defnInfo definition) =>
      unless definition.safety == .safe do
        failures := failures.push "instBEqExpr.beq is not a safe definition"
  | _ => failures := failures.push "instBEqExpr.beq has no total definition body"
  for (name, information) in environment.constants.toList do
    let some moduleIndex := environment.getModuleIdxFor? name | continue
    if environment.header.moduleNames[moduleIndex.toNat]? !=
        some `Effect4.Target.TypeScript.Expr then
      continue
    let safeCompilerCompanion := match Lean.Compiler.isUnsafeRecName? name with
      | some sourceName => match environment.find? sourceName with
        | some (.defnInfo sourceInfo) => sourceInfo.safety == .safe
        | _ => false
      | none => false
    if !safeCompilerCompanion && (information.isPartial || information.isUnsafe) then
      failures := failures.push s!"non-total Expr declaration: {name}"
  unless failures.isEmpty do
    throwError "Expr equality trust regression(s):\n{String.intercalate "\n" failures.toList}"
  logInfo "PASS Expr module declarations have total safe definitions or compiler companions of them"

end ExprEqualityTrustRegression
